purpose: This table provides cleaned hourly weather observations for the three NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) covering January through June 2013, feeding downstream analyses that join flight delays and schedules to local weather conditions.
usage: Consumers should join on origin_code and time_hour to align with the flights table's origin column, and read temperature_fahrenheit, dewpoint_fahrenheit, humidity_percent, wind_direction_degrees, wind_speed_mph, wind_gust_mph, precipitation_inches, pressure_millibars, and visibility_miles in their documented units; wind_direction_degrees, wind_speed_mph, pressure_millibars, and especially wind_gust_mph carry nulls and must be filtered or coalesced deliberately before aggregation.
limitations: Local calendar date is still represented as separate year, month, day, and hour integer columns rather than a single DATE column, because the proposal format allows only one action per source column and cannot merge them; consumers needing a local calendar date should derive it from these fields, while the UTC instant is available directly in time_hour. wind_gust_mph is sparsely populated (74.6% null, 9702 of 13014 rows) and pressure_millibars is null in 11.5% of rows (1496 of 13014); these nulls are retained rather than imputed or used to drop rows.
